NOISE ABATEMENT PROCEDURES - AMEND PARA C/ TO READ:
ARRIVALS FROM THE NORTH FOR RWY 05 ARE TO ROUTE THROUGH THE
TITCHFIELD GYRATORY AND ON TO DOWNWIND FOR RUNWAY 05. ARRIVALS FROM
THE NORTH FOR RWY 23 ARE TO ROUTE OVERHEAD WICKHAM VRP, MAINTAIN A
SOUTHERLY HEADING AND 2100' UNTIL OVERHEAD THE SOLENT, THEN DESCEND
TO JOIN DOWNWIND FOR RUNWAY 23. BASE JOINS FOR RUNWAY 23 ARE
PROHIBITED.
UK AIP EGHF AD 2.21 REFERS.
